name: Burden
source:
A quiet journey through a town suspended in ritual and silence, where two travelers confront faith, loss, and the unsettling comfort of surrender.

Burden (BurdƎEn) is a short Kinetic Sound Visual Novel developed in under a month as a personal proof of concept and challenge. It is a standalone prologue or Act 1, imagined as the opening act of a larger work that may never come to be.
